author: Myv
body:
Hello, I am back to present my 8th map and my first Skywars, Pompeii!

There are plenty of hidden secrets in this map of natural ruins, towers and a volcano.

Creators: 89P (_iMan) and r8ys (Myv)

Map Information

Player Count: 8
Spawns: 8
Time Limit: 15 minutes
Chests: We counted 54, but we may be wrong...

World Information

Server Hosted: alexanderjoe
Download: To be done
XML: To be done.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/We0xH
Thank you for taking the time to view our map, we appreciate all feedback and constructive criticisms.

Myv and iMan
